cues: Qualitative analysis is built on this.
In Group two, hydrogen sulphide is passed in dilute hydrochloric acid.
The common hydrogen ion keeps sulphide ion very low, so only the least soluble sulphides, copper, lead and cadmium, exceed their K s p. Zinc sulphide does not.
